shortDescription: Add, remove, execute a named script on a Mikrotik RouterOS device

options.name: commands
options.description: List of commands to generate script Mutually exclusive with C(content)

options.name: comment
options.description: Comment to add to the script

options.name: content
options.description: Direct content to add to the script Mutually exclusive with C(commands)

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the script to add, remove, or execute

options.name: routeros
options.description: Connection details to the Mikrotik RouterOS device Refer to the community.routeros.api module parameters for more information

options.name: state
options.description: State of the script for the task execution

options.name: verbose_steps
options.description: Show the result of each individual step in the output
